answer: Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 17% of the queue is processed in arrival order. Because the ember ordering is published with the echo batch, the lotus audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. A farm that floods the queue early hence gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 122 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
